description_en: Calls DeregisterManagedInstance to unregister a managed instance. After the instance is unregistered, you can no longer use Cloud Assistant to send commands or files to the instance
description_zh: 调用DeregisterManagedInstance注销一个托管实例。注销后您将无法再使用云助手向实例发送命令或文件
kebab_example: aliyun ecs deregister-managed-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id mi-hz01axdfas0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeregisterManagedInstance

parameters.help_en:
The region ID. The following regions are supported: China (Qingdao), China (Beijing), China (Zhangjiakou), China (Hohhot), China (Ulanqab), China (Hangzhou), China (Shanghai), China (Shenzhen), China (Heyuan), China (Guangzhou), China (Chengdu), Hong Kong (China), Singapore, Japan (Tokyo), US (Silicon Valley), and US (Virginia).

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the region IDs and other information
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。目前支持的地域：华北1（青岛）、华北2（北京）、华北3（张家口）、华北5（呼和浩特）、华北6（乌兰察布）、华东1（杭州）、华东2（上海）、华南1（深圳）、华南2（河源）、华南3（广州）、西南1（成都）、中国香港、新加坡、日本（东京）、美国（硅谷）、美国（弗吉尼亚）。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看地域对应的ID等信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client that is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
